sources.title: canada-quant (Canada Quant Labs) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: AI & ML interests Canada Quant Labs — Canada's open-weight model lab. We train, quantize, and ship sovereign reference models for regulated industries (legal, medical, defence, finance) on a DGX B300 at Equinix Vancouver. Upstream contributors to vLLM and llm-compressor. Recipes: W4A16, NVFP4, MXFP4.

sources.title: Canada Quant Labs - GitHub
sources.snippet: GLM-5.2 (744B MoE, ~40B active, MLA + DeepSeek Sparse Attention, native 1M context, MIT). We shipped one artifact: W4A16 INT4 on the routed experts with the BF16 MTP draft head preserved for speculative decoding (attention, dense layers 0-2, shared experts, router, embeddings, lm_head, and MTP layer 78 stay BF16).

sources.title: Running GLM-5.2 on half the GPUs: a W4A16 + MTP quantization
sources.snippet: A 4-bit weight quant of GLM-5.2 (744B MoE) that keeps the MTP draft head in BF16 — matching FP8 on quality, fitting on four H200s instead of eight, and fastest of the popular 4-bit quants in the interactive regime.
